tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The tenant (id, name, timeZone, currency), the scopes of the API key in use and the plan (id, label, bookingsPerMonth, usedThisMonth, level ok|warn|full). Works with any valid key. Call first to learn which tools your key may use and, when writing fails with 402 plan_limit, what the account's plan a

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new account (project) for a client, owned by this account's first owner — the agency case: one login or key configures several client sites. The new account starts on Free; the allowance is the highest `projects` among the plans of the accounts that owner owns (Free/Pro 1, Agency 5, € 9 per

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: All services of the tenant (simple, compound, collaborative, package), ordered by position. Scope catalog:read. Paginated: limit ≤ 100 (default 50), offset; returns {data, total}.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: One service by id. Scope catalog:read.

tools.name: create_service
tools.description: Create a service; missing fields get admin defaults (type simple, duration 60, deposit 100%, taxRate 21). `type` cannot change later. A service is bookable once visibility is public and a public staff member with a schedule offers it (assign_staff_service). Scope catalog:write.

tools.name: update_service
tools.description: Partial update: send only the fields that change (merged over current values). `type` is fixed. Scope catalog:write.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Service categories, ordered by position. Scope catalog:read. Paginated: limit ≤ 100 (default 50), offset; returns {data, total}.

tools.name: list_staff
tools.description: All staff members, including archived ones (visibility = archive). Scope catalog:read. Paginated: limit ≤ 100 (default 50), offset; returns {data, total}.

tools.name: get_staff
tools.description: One staff member by id. Scope catalog:read.

tools.name: create_staff
tools.description: Create a staff member; the weekly schedule starts as a copy of the business hours. Link services with assign_staff_service afterwards. Scope catalog:write.

tools.name: update_staff
tools.description: Partial update of a staff member. visibility "archive" hides them (staff are never deleted). Scope catalog:write.

tools.name: get_staff_schedule
tools.description: Weekly working hours of a staff member: {days: [{weekday 1=Mon…7=Sun, start, end, breaks}]}. A missing weekday is a day off. Scope catalog:read.

tools.name: set_staff_schedule
tools.description: Replace the WHOLE week of a staff member (not a merge): send every working day; a missing weekday becomes a day off. end > start, breaks inside the day and not overlapping. Read it first with get_staff_schedule. Scope catalog:write.

tools.name: list_staff_services
tools.description: Services this staff member offers, with per-link price, capacityMin/Max and deposit. Scope catalog:read. Paginated: limit ≤ 100 (default 50), offset; returns {data, total}.

tools.name: assign_staff_service
tools.description: Let a staff member offer a service (create or update the link). Missing fields keep current link values, or for a new link the service price/capacity and deposit null (= service deposit). Required before a staff member can be booked for the service. Scope catalog:write.

tools.name: unassign_staff_service
tools.description: Stop a staff member offering a service. Existing appointments stay. Scope catalog:write.

tools.name: get_business_hours
tools.description: Company opening hours {days: [{weekday 1=Mon…7=Sun, start, end}]}; a missing weekday = closed. New staff copy these. Scope settings:read.

tools.name: set_business_hours
tools.description: Replace ALL business hours (not a merge): one entry per open weekday, no breaks; a missing weekday = closed. Does not change existing staff schedules. Scope settings:write.

tools.name: list_holidays
tools.description: Days off. staffId filters: a staff id, or "company" for company-wide days; omit for all. Scope catalog:read. Paginated: limit ≤ 100 (default 50), offset; returns {data, total}.

tools.name: add_holiday
tools.description: Add a day off. kind: once | yearly (same date every year) | exception (a working day despite company days off). staffId null/omitted = company-wide. Scope catalog:write.

tools.name: delete_holiday
tools.description: Remove a day off by id (from list_holidays). Scope catalog:write.

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: All admin-editable tenant settings, plus read-only id, publicKey (for the widget / public API) and currency. Scope settings:read.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.description: Partial update: only fields present are validated and written; returns all settings. id, publicKey and currency are read-only. The Mollie key is set via api_request PUT /settings/mollie-key {key} (scope payments:write) before payMollieEnabled: true. Scope settings:write.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: Customers, optionally searched with q (name, e-mail or phone). Scope customers:read. Paginated: limit ≤ 100 (default 50), offset; returns {data, total}.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id. Scope customers:read.

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer. email is unique per tenant: 409 when it exists, so search with list_customers first. Scope customers:write.

tools.name: update_customer
tools.description: Partial update of a customer. Scope customers:write.

tools.name: list_appointments
tools.description: The calendar: appointments with their bookings and customers. Filter by from/to (ISO date-times; start ≥ from, < to), staffId, serviceId, status (appointments having a booking in that status). Scope bookings:read. Paginated: limit ≤ 100 (default 50), offset; returns {data, total}.

tools.name: get_appointment
tools.description: One appointment with bookings (bookingId, status, persons), customers, extras, series/group ids and meetingUrl. Scope bookings:read.

tools.name: create_appointment
tools.description: Book like the admin: one appointment with one booking. Give customerId or customer {name, email, phone}. Without end the service duration is used; without status the tenant default. A day service (rental, durationDays > 0) starts at the local midnight (00:00) and without end spans its number of days

tools.name: update_appointment
tools.description: Move or change an appointment: send only what changes (start, end, staffId, serviceId, internalNote). start without end keeps the service duration (for a day service: its number of days); besides, a day service starts at the local midnight (00:00). scope following|series shifts later/all appointment

tools.name: delete_appointment
tools.description: Delete an appointment and its bookings. notify: true first sets approved bookings to cancelled and pending ones to rejected and mails the customers. To cancel but keep the record, use update_booking status cancelled instead. scope this|following|series for recurring series. Scope bookings:write.

tools.name: add_customer_to_appointment
tools.description: Add another booking (customer) to an existing group appointment. Give customerId or customer {name, email, phone}. 409 capacity_exceeded when it does not fit. Response includes the new bookingId. Scope bookings:write.

tools.name: update_booking
tools.description: Change a booking's status (approve, cancel, reject, done…) and/or persons. id is the bookingId (from create_appointment or get_appointment), not the appointment id. The status also applies to other parts of the same compound/collaborative group; scope following|series applies it to a recurring serie

tools.name: find_slots
tools.description: Bookable times for a service, day by day, exactly as the booking widget sees them (respects schedules, days off, existing bookings, capacity, minimum notice and booking horizon). Returns {days: [{date, slots: [{start, time, staffId, state?}]}], hasMore}; days without free times are omitted. Pass a s

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: Payments, newest first. Filters: status (pending|completed|rejected|refunded), type (local|free|mollie), customerId. Scope payments:read. Paginated: limit ≤ 100 (default 50), offset; returns {data, total}.

tools.name: get_payment
tools.description: One payment with its items and bookings. Mark a local payment paid / refund it via api_request POST /payments/{id}/complete or /refund (payments:write). Scope payments:read.

tools.name: list_outbox
tools.description: The e-mail log, newest first: what was sent or queued (id, status, toEmail, toName, subject, text, html, createdAt, sentAt, lastError). On a sandbox nothing is delivered: rows end as status "suppressed", read them here to verify confirmations. Filters: status (pending|sending|sent|failed|suppressed)

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Ticketed events ordered by startAt. Ticket types, attendees and event staff are under /events/{id}/… via api_request. Scope catalog:read. Paginated: limit ≤ 100 (default 50), offset; returns {data, total}.

tools.name: list_coupons
tools.description: Coupons (discount codes) ordered by code. Scope catalog:read. Paginated: limit ≤ 100 (default 50), offset; returns {data, total}.

tools.name: generate_coupons
tools.description: Create up to 100 unique coupon codes from a mask: every * becomes one of 0-9A-Z (e.g. "SUMMER-****"). The other fields are the template for each coupon; discount (percent) or deduction must be > 0. 422 on mask when it is used up. Returns {data: coupons}. Single coupons: api_request POST /coupons. Sc

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: Webhook endpoints (id, url, events, active, description, createdAt, updatedAt); the secret is never returned. Event types with descriptions: api_request GET /webhooks/events. Scope settings:read. Paginated: limit ≤ 100 (default 50), offset; returns {data, total}.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register a URL that receives signed POSTs (Standard Webhooks: webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature "v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>" over "id.timestamp.body" keyed with the base64 part of the secret after whsec_). Payloads are thin ({id, type, createdAt, tenantId, data: ids + status, previousSta

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete an endpoint and its delivery log. To pause instead: api_request PATCH /webhooks/{id} {active: false}. New secret: POST /webhooks/{id}/rotate-secret. Scope settings:write.

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Queue a `ping` event ({type: "ping", data: {endpointId}}) to the endpoint and send it right away. Returns the delivery (202); check the outcome (status delivered/pending, lastStatus, lastError) with list_webhook_deliveries a second later. Scope settings:write.

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Delivery log of one endpoint, newest first: id, eventId, type, status (pending|sending|delivered|failed), attempts, nextAttemptAt, lastStatus (HTTP), lastError, createdAt, deliveredAt, payload. Resend one: api_request POST /webhooks/{id}/deliveries/{deliveryId}/retry. Scope settings:read. Paginated:

tools.name: api_request
tools.description: Any /api/v1 management API call not covered by a dedicated tool. path is relative to /api/v1 (e.g. "/services/<uuid>/extras"), ids in place of {…}; put query parameters in query, the JSON body in body (camelCase). Same scopes and errors as the API: {error: {code, message, fields}}. Lists take limit

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_customer, get_payment, list_outbox, list_events, list_webhooks, create_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries, api_request · Private data: whoami, delete_appointment, list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook, api_request · Public sink: update_service, set_staff_schedule, create_customer, create_appointment, update_appointment, delete_appointment, add_customer_to_appointment, update_booking, get_payment, generate_coupons, list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries, api_request · Destructive: delete_holiday, delete_appointment, delete_webhook, api_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_customer, get_payment, list_outbox, list_events, list_webhooks, create_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries, api_request · Private data: whoami, delete_appointment, list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook, api_request · Public sink: update_service, set_staff_schedule, create_customer, create_appointment, update_appointment, delete_appointment, add_customer_to_appointment, update_booking, get_payment, generate_coupons, list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries, api_request · Destructive: delete_holiday, delete_appointment, delete_webhook, api_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
